articles.title: Deputy Russian Defence Minister Vasily Osmakov holds talks with ICRC's head of regional delegation Rania Machlab
articles.summary: On April 1, 2026, Deputy Russian Defence Minister Vasily Osmakov met with Rania Machlab, Head of the ICRC's regional delegation for Russia and Belarus. This significant interaction likely addressed humanitarian concerns, such as prisoner welfare, civilian protection, or access for aid, consistent with the ICRC's critical role in conflict zones. Such engagements are vital for upholding international humanitarian law.

articles.title: Defence budget under capital head fully utilised in FY2025-26
articles.summary: India has fully utilized its defence budget allocated under the capital head for the Fiscal Year 2025-26. This significant achievement indicates efficient expenditure on acquisitions and modernization programs crucial for strengthening the nation's military capabilities and ensuring preparedness for future challenges. Such complete utilization is vital for defense readiness, reflecting strategic financial management.
